dedupe_keys.name: e plan emergency response information system hazmat data for first responders

description: E-Plan is a web-based emergency response information system that gives first responders the hazardous chemical inventories reported by facilities under EPCRA Tier II, for use in responses to severe weather, hazmat accidents or terrorist threats and in planning for them. Facilities and businesses in participating states can also file their Tier II reports through its online filing system, and the site offers training, user guides, a plume chemicals list and mobile apps for Android and iPhone. It is operated by the University of Texas at Dallas with the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. Coverage is the United States, with state pages listed for Alabama, Alaska, Florida, Georgia, Iowa, Montana, New York, North Carolina, South Carolina and Tennessee among others. Use is free for authorised users, but access is restricted: hazmat data are shown only to federal, state and local responders with individual accounts, typically limited to their own area. Caveats: researchers cannot use the data directly, and content depends on which states route Tier II filings through E-Plan. For simulation it is an example of the operational system through which chemical storage data reach responders, relevant when modelling emergency response to chemical releases. It is related to the EPCRA Tier II hazardous chemical inventory reports record in this catalogue, the data it serves.
